meena uses your location for local weather, prayer times and the nearby map. you can choose approximate on the next screen. weather and air quality only get your area to about 1 km, and openfreemap gets the part of the map you look at. no background tracking.
meena reads your calendar to show today\'s events. your events stay on your phone.
no analytics, no ads and no background tracking. your portfolio is stored encrypted on your phone. only what weather, prayer times, news and rates need goes online.

notifications, bank alerts, calendar events and health stats are read on your phone and never leave it. no analytics, no ads, no tracking.
